item: The boot sequence's slow-step watchdog Timer is named and joins the ambient threads of the GET walk
summary: boot_sequence._SlowWatch armed an anonymous threading.Timer (300 s, re-armed while a step is slow), and one thread starts at the beginning of every boot step, so a walk against a booted server would have put an unattributable Thread-N on an innocent route (the F4 class, found by the #1566 read). It is named oo-boot-slow-watch and the walk's ambient-thread pattern lists it; the new unit test was red on the unnamed timer first. Not measured on a route: both CI walks set OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1, so no boot sequence runs inside a walk and this thread was never seen there; the allowance is defensive.
